Composition: a wide seascape seen from just above the water surface at eye level with the waves, a low horizon at about 62% of the height. The left 60% of the canvas stays calm: flat sea mist sky and quiet navy water with only sparse halftone ripples, reserved for a title overlay. Every diver is a generic, fictional Jeju haenyeo woman, not any real person, wearing a black rubber wetsuit with a hood and a round diving mask, shown from behind or as a silhouette so no face is visible.
